tagline: Eho-Altissa取景器相机，1958 年发布
description:
Altix is a series of sophisticated 35mm viewfinder cameras, made by Eho-Altissa and its successors in Dresden, Germany, from 1938 onwards., p.257-8

Production restarted after the war, and later models starting with the Altissa V from 1954, have interchangeable lenses.
